description: One key as a key cap, with real <kbd> semantics: the shortcut hint next to a CommandPalette trigger, a menu row, a help sheet. One Kbd per key; compose a combination as siblings with a plain "+" between them.
example:
/* One Kbd per key; the "+" between them is plain text. This is the hint that * sits next to a CommandPalette trigger or in a shortcuts help sheet. */

Press Ctrl+K to open the command palette.
